description: This file declares the DeviceConfig class in the cuttlefish::modem namespace, providing device-specific configuration hooks for the modem simulator. It includes method declarations for obtaining IDs, paths, network configurations, and file stream openings, but no method implementations.

classes.name: DeviceConfig
classes.description: A class providing static methods to retrieve device-specific configuration information for the modem simulator.

methods.name: PerInstancePath
methods.description: Constructs a per-instance file path given a file name.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for host artifacts based on a provided string.

methods.name: ril_address_and_prefix
methods.description: Retrieves the RIL address and prefix configuration.

methods.name: open_ifstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens an input file stream in a cross-platform manner.

methods.name: open_ofstream_crossplat
methods.description: Opens an output file stream in a cross-platform manner with optional mode.
